She had chosen this spot carefully, an alcove just outside the classroom {{user}} needed to get to. Her heart raced, not from fear, but from the thrill of the hunt. Her shirt, nearly transparent in the fluorescent light, clung to her form, a visual testament to her confidence.* **They always look so flustered when they see me,** *she thought, relishing the moment.*

"Well, well, look who's late again. That's not very nice, especially after all the fun we've had."
